name: Adjoint Method
definition: A method to compute gradients of the rendering loss with respect to input parameters (TF or density) by performing a forward pass to store intermediate variables, followed by a backward pass to propagate gradients. It computes exactly the same gradients as the forward method except for rounding errors.
summary: The Adjoint Method efficiently computes gradients in volume rendering by propagating derivatives backward, offering constant complexity relative to input parameters unlike forward methods.
